bullets.content: [general] Never apply the tweak a playbook note literally names (e.g. 'flank zmin 0.020'). a2 and a12 both did: identical 6765-node meshes, zero bonus, a repeated tie. Choose a change no note suggests and check node counts against known meshes.

[general] Boxes on thin walls deliver ~1.3x their request (flank 0.003 gave h 0.0039-0.0042 at saddle hotspots). Points centred on a hotspot with radius >=2x size deliver closer to the request. Verify hotspot local h after the solve.

[general] Change exactly ONE factor per solve (h OR one refinement's size/radius/place). Repeated mistakes: changing h and dropping/adding several refinements at once made compare changes unattributable.

[general] Use all 4 solves: (1) new recipe, (2) single-factor tweak at the cluster of the top hotspot, (3) tweak at next cluster or a DOF cut, (4) best combination. compare two different solves before submit. Submit by calibrated e*DOFs.
[general] After solve 1 (order 2) call view(kind=error); write the 5 hotspots with local h before the next mesh. Skipping it twice hid the +y lobe (h 0.004, 8-11% VM).

[general] The mesher is deterministic: identical calls give identical node counts (5932). Exact reruns measure no noise. compare() differences of 3-5% between meshes with +/-4% DOFs are the remeshing noise floor; do not choose on them.

[general] Box radius had no effect: bottom box r0.004 vs r0.006 gave an identical mesh (5871 nodes). Vary box extent or add a second larger coarser box, not radius. Check the node count changed before spending a solve.
[general] Never call compare(x,x) (returned 3e-15). Write the pair (candidate, reference) with two different solve numbers first.

[general] Avoid submitting a mesh identical to a peer's (a solve 2 equalled a11's node for node). Ties pay no hidden-point bonus and kill the diversity bonus. Differ deliberately in at least one factor.

[general] When following a template recipe, copy its refinement list verbatim first and diff only the assigned factor. A template with different targets is a new recipe and teaches nothing controlled.
[general] A refinement size >=0.9x the existing local h does nothing. To move a hotspot ask for <=0.6x its local h (e.g. <=0.0026-0.003 where h is 0.0043) and verify its local h next solve.
[general] Before trimming or shrinking a box, list every hotspot >=3% inside it with its local h. Trim only if none falls outside; dropping a 10%+ hotspot costs more energy than the DOFs saved.
[general] Boxes narrower than 2x their size under-deliver. Request about 0.8x the desired local h and verify node count and local h change.

[general] Above target score ~1/(e*DOFs): a cheaper solve wins if e_cheap < e_ref*N_ref/N_cheap (15978 DOFs needed <9.44% vs 8.22% at 18342). Estimate e with compare against the FINEST mesh, not adjacent ones.
[general] Above the 2x target, base = 1063/(e*DOFs) on this task. Report e*DOFs for every candidate; uniform scaling breaks even (x0.9: 1469).
[general] Change one factor per mesh call. Changing bottom-box and f7 radii together made the 61-node drop unattributable. Diff your call against the template line by line before meshing.
[general] For an order switch scale ALL sizes (h and local) by (vertices_P2/target_vertices)^(1/3); P1 vs P2 at equal DOFs is ~0.5-0.55 (estimate). Verify node count.
[general] Rank 6 with target met (gain 2.94) means cost term (0.48) hurts. Test fewer DOFs (~15k at <9% error) via a tighter box.
[general] compare(a,b) with b at 1.5x DOFs gave 5.98% vs true 7.47% (x1.25). Scale by 1.25 when estimating e*DOFs.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] I ranked 8/8 copying a peer recipe (a14) with a tiny change. Make a structurally different attempt: change h or body box size by >1.3x to earn diversity.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Price the explorer mesh before solving: aim 6300-6900 nodes, quality >=0.1. If nodes >7000 raise upper box to 0.0066; if quality <0.1 raise point radii to 0.008. If nodes within 1% of 6765, 6697, 7073, 7075, 7152 or 6932, change a point size by >=10%.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Wall cells x±0.0058, |y|0.0129, z0.0255 hold ~12% of error at h0.0044-0.0047 (37-40 elements); flank boxes miss them. Target with points/boxes at 0.003 r0.005-0.006.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp-ring error (13.9%, 4 cells z0.0561) at |y|~0.015, x 0-0.006, ~0.9mm inside wall off f20, h0.004. f2 and edge 40 sizing miss it; try point (0.002,±0.0149,0.0556) 0.0025 r0.007.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Flank-box size ladder (zmin0.020): 0.0026 7642 nodes 0.033535J; 0.003 6765 0.033445; 0.0036 6081 0.033185 (only 0.78% energy). 0.003 is the e²N optimum; flank size is not the lever, don't retest.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Keep lower body z0-0.021 at <=0.0054 (cells near f20/f23 z0.005 and under boss z0.015 vary 4-5%). Coarsen only upper zone (0.0062) to pay for points.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a15 (17.4% field, best): junction box [-0.024,-0.018,0.018,0.024,0.018,0.038] 0.004 r0.006 under flanks 0.003 covers wall cells, but +5.7% DOFs; points can do it cheaper.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Error diffuse (245 hotspots, ~3% each, h~0.004). Test uniformly finer body box 0.0042-0.0045 over z0-0.0575 with coarser f2 to trade DOFs; and box z0.048-0.0575 at 0.0035 for upper shaft cells (3.4-3.6%).
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] f15/f17 boss end faces h0.0082 are low-stress; leave coarse.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup 3d, f2 fixed, 4e6 Pa on f23, 2.1e6 Pa on f16, E2.1e11, nu0.3: equilibrium valid. Keep.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Pay line vs control (0.033445J, 20295 DOFs, 17.9%, e²N 650): ~0.12-0.2 field pts per 0.1% energy. Submit point recipe if energy >=0.03340J at <=20k DOFs or >=0.03350J at <=21.5k; else best e²N of own solves.
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Cost term 0.298 (20295 vs 6057 DOFs) dominated loss. Test 12-14k DOFs at ~20% error; try h0.014 keeping body box.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] [general] Bottom box 0.0025 (15978 DOFs, 8.29% vs ref) and a9's 0.0026 (9.70% at 15.8k) gave no score gain. Do not retest single-box size; use the two-tier band. Do not coarsen below 0.002 for savings (e*DOFs ~12% worse).

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] a4 recipe at bottom 0.0016 needs no solve: 5705 nodes, energy 2.13564e-4, true field 8.15%. Price bottom 0.0013/0.0014/0.0015 with free mesh() calls; if 0.0014 >~6200 nodes or min_quality<0.1, use 0.0015.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Solve plan: s1 bottom 0.0014; s2 bottom 0.0012; s3 x0.75 reference of the better; s4 only if needed. Compare s1 vs s2 and each vs reference; read clamp-hotspot local h each solve.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] +y lobe near f38/f43 (x 0.016-0.022, y~0.02) has worst VM errors (7.7-10.9%) at h 0.004. Band 0.0032 delivered only 0.00396; request 0.003 and verify f38 h<=0.0035. A box thinner than ~2x its size under-delivers: request ~0.8x desired local h.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspots #5/#6 (f38/f43, y~0.02, z -0.004..0) lie outside every box. Test box [0.012,0.012,-0.0081,0.028,0.024,0.0] 0.003 r0.003, dropping equivalent bottom-tier volume, as a placement variant. Do not extend upper box ymax to 0.024.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Hotspot #5 near f12/+y lobe (0.014,0.0177,-0.0067) h 0.0043, 5% VM. Test box [0.010,0.010,-0.0081,0.028,0.024,-0.004] at 0.0032 with a coarser upper box, moving DOFs rather than adding.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Never move tier1/bottom-box xmin above 0.015: narrowing to x 0.021 dropped f5-side hotspots (15% of error), energy 2.13524->2.13200e-4 for -4% DOFs. f5 clamp corner is hotspot #1 in 6 of 8 runs.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Clamp-layer hotspots (z~-0.0073, f5/f7 bottoms) are saturated: at h 0.0022 they hold 29-30% of energy but only 3-4% VM. Tier1 0.0016 vs 0.0018 break-even; keep 0.0018, do not shrink bottom tiers.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Top 4 hotspots (~32% energy) at f7/f5 bottoms, z -0.007, h 0.0025, VM only 4-5%: saturated, but a11's tier1 0.0016 reached h 0.0023 and best field 7.79% (19k DOFs), so the layer still responds below 0.0025.
